findings.title: Bed filter on the Waterings page is lost on reload or when the link is shared
findings.steps: Open /waterings and pick 'Shade corner' in the Bed filter. The URL changes to ?bed_id=2. Reload the page or open that URL directly.
findings.expected: The list stays filtered to Shade corner.
findings.actual: The page reads ?bed= but writes ?bed_id=, so a reload shows 'All beds' and every watering. Back and forward don't update the filter either.
findings.evidence: SSR of /waterings?bed_id=2 shows 'All beds' selected and '3 waterings, 14 L in total' across both beds. /waterings?bed=2 is filtered. Code: waterings.vue reads route.query.bed but router.replace sets {bed_id}.

findings.title: A very large bed id gives a 500 on every watering endpoint
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error with a plain-text body. Validation allows any int > 0, and SQLite overflows on it.
findings.evidence: All three requests returned 'Internal Server Error 500'.

findings.title: Small amounts show as '0 L'
findings.steps: Record a past watering with litres 0.001. The UI allows it with step 0.1 and novalidate, and the API accepts anything > 0.
findings.expected: The amount shown as it was saved, or refused.
findings.evidence: After POST litres 0.001, the dashboard and /waterings rendered 'North bed 0 L'.

findings.title: Absurd past dates such as year 0001 are accepted
findings.steps: POST {"bed_id":1,"watered_on":"0001-01-01"}, or type year 0001 in the date field.
findings.expected: A refusal with a reason (no lower bound on the date today).
findings.actual: 201 Created. The entry is stored and shows in the history.

findings.title: Waterings list and dashboard widget have no retry when loading fails
findings.steps: Stop the API or force an error (e.g. /waterings?bed=abc), then load the page.
findings.expected: An error state with a Retry button that refetches without a reload.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage with no retry. The dashboard doesn't even take refresh for waterings. With a bad bed in the URL, the raw message 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer...' shows, and Clear filter is the only way out.
findings.evidence: SSR of /waterings?bed=abc shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer' with no retry control. Code: index.vue destructures only data/error for waterings.

findings.title: Bed filter fails silently when the beds request fails
findings.steps: Make GET /api/beds fail (server error or timeout) while /api/waterings works.
findings.expected: An error telling the user the bed list could not load, with a retry.
findings.actual: The bedsResult error is ignored. The dropdown shows only 'All beds', as if there were no beds.
findings.evidence: Code: const { data: beds } = bedsResult; no error handling.

findings.title: No 10-second timeout on watering requests
findings.where: /beds Water now / Save watering, /waterings delete, list loads
findings.steps: Make the API hang (slow network) and click Water now.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s with a visible error, and the button is enabled again.
findings.actual: No timeout is set on useApiFetch or the $fetch client. The button stays on 'Watering…' (disabled) for as long as the request hangs.
findings.evidence: Code: useApiClient/$fetch.create and the useApiFetch calls set no timeout.

findings.title: Retrying 'Water now' or 'Save watering' after a timeout or network error records a second watering
findings.steps: Click Water now. The request reaches the server but the response is lost or slow. The user sees an error and clicks again.
findings.actual: POST has no idempotency key or dedupe, so each retry inserts another row.
findings.evidence: Code: create_watering always INSERTs; the client sends no request id.

findings.title: Retrying a delete shows an error even though the watering was deleted
findings.steps: Delete a watering whose first response is lost or times out, then click Delete again.
findings.expected: The row is gone and no error is shown.
findings.actual: The second DELETE returns 404 'Watering not found.', which shows as an error, and the stale row stays until refresh.
findings.evidence: A repeat DELETE /api/waterings/4 returned 404 {"detail":"Watering not found."}.

findings.title: A late list response can overwrite the newer filter's results
findings.steps: Quickly switch the Bed filter A -> B on a slow connection.
findings.expected: The list shown matches the selected bed.
findings.actual: Relies on useFetch's reactive query refetching. The change adds no request ordering. Low risk if Nuxt cancels the previous fetch.

findings.title: Past watering for 'today' can be refused when the browser and server are in different time zones
findings.steps: In a browser time zone ahead of the server, record a past watering with today's date (the form default).
findings.actual: The server checks date.today() in server-local time and answers 'Watering date cannot be in the future.' 'Water now' also stores watered_on as the server-local date, not the gardener's.
findings.evidence: Code: schemas.WateringIn.not_in_future uses date.today(); the client uses todayIso() max.
